messages:
Maddy: quick sync — landing copy pass for the tri-mode pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need final edits by EOD Thu so we can publish launch posts + wire up the webinar landing.
Casey: 👍 can we tighten the hero? current feels vague. options:
  A) Predictable LLM inference at scale
  B) Fast, affordable LLM serving for production
  C) Inference you can trust — hosted, dedicated, private
Which leans more technical for our audience? i vote A.
Jordan: A works. i'll nudge hero type to 48/36 and test CTA prominence. recommend primary CTA: "Start free trial" (hosted) and a secondary: "Talk to sales" for Dedicated/Private.
Priya: For launch posts and the benchmark narrative we need 3 clear claims + link to methodology. Suggested claims:
  - 2–3x lower cost per token vs baseline (agg across bursty workloads)
  - 25–40% lower median latency with smart batching
  - Predictable tail latency under 200ms for 95p on small models
Also we should include a short explainer about how we measure (seq len, batch mix). link: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks
Liam: draft microcopy for heroes and feature bullets:
  - Hero (A): "Predictable LLM inference at scale"
  - Subhead: "Hosted API for fast time-to-value. Dedicated capacity for committed throughput. Private deployments for regulated data."
  - Bullets: "Transparent SLOs", "Model rollouts & canaries", "Autoscaling + burst capacity"
Maddy: love it. can we make the subhead 1 line on mobile? shorten to: "Hosted, Dedicated, or Private — one API for production inference."
Casey: +1. Also tweak CTA text per mode: hosted -> "Start free trial"; dedicated -> "Reserve capacity"; private -> "Request demo".
Priya: inbound routing note: webinar registrants with "deployment interest" set to Dedicated or Private should create a high-intent lead for AE follow-up. Hosted signups go to self-serve nurture.
Maddy: agreed. can we add a hidden form field on the landing that captures selection? snippet:
```
<input type="hidden" name="deployment_interest" id="deployment_interest" value="hosted|dedicated|private">
```
and map that to HubSpot field `deployment_interest`.
Jordan: confirmed — i'll add the dropdown and hide it for AB test where users can explicitly pick. design will show inline microcopy: "Which deployment are you evaluating?"
Liam: for the webinar description (short blurb): "Live demo + benchmarks: See how to cut inference costs and deliver reliable latency across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Q&A on migration patterns and rollout strategies."
Priya: plan for launch posts: 1) benchmark-focused post with charts + methodology, 2) product announcement highlighting tri-mode API, 3) webinar sign-up push. Post cadence: day 0, day 3, day 10.
Maddy: good. tagging owners: Priya owns post cadence + socials, Liam owns copy, Jordan owns landing design, Casey owns tracking + analytics.
Casey: tracking checklist:
  - UTMs for each post (utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch, utm_content=benchmark|product|webinar)
  - hidden field deployment_interest
  - form property "intent_level" (webinar question) -> if >=4 then AE alert
  - segment events: 'webinar_registrant', 'landing_signup_hosted', 'contact_sales'
Priya: we'll set an automation: webinar registrants -> nurture sequence + 1 AE notification for Dedicated/Private picks. can you work with ops on SLA? need 4hr follow-up.
events-bot: Event created: "Tri-mode inference webinar" on 2024-04-07 10:00 PT — calendar invite shared.
Maddy: final asks before EOD pass:
  - Liam: 2 hero variants + one-line mobile subhead
  - Jordan: add hidden field + dropdown mock + updated CTA sizes
  - Casey: implement UTMs + form mappings in analytics doc
  - Priya: social copy hooks + three post schedule
I'll collect all in this doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/tri-mode-landing-copy
ack? :thumbsup:
Casey: ack.
Liam: on it, will push drafts to the doc by 1pm.
Jordan: will update Figma and drop link.
Priya: prepping campaign calendar and tracking sheet.
Maddy: thanks team — will review final pass 4pm and freeze content for engineering to push.
